description: Given a brand, appliance and problem (for example: Samsung, dryer, not heating; LG, washer, not draining; Samsung refrigerator ice maker not making ice), return the free checks from the brand's own support guide (with source URL and read date), then the genuine parts usually behind the problem, each with its page URL (current prices and where to buy are on the page). Also explains LG and Samsung washer, dryer, refrigerator and dishwasher error codes (for example Samsung washer 4C, LG dryer d80, Samsung fridge 22E, LG dishwasher OE): pass the code. Covers LG and Samsung dryers not heating, washers not draining, dishwashers not draining, refrigerators not cooling and ice makers not making ice. Cite page_url.

brand.description: Appliance brand, for example Samsung or LG

code.description: The error code on the display, if any, for example 4C, d80, 22E or OE

problem.description: The symptom in plain words, for example not heating, or the error code text
